events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 boost their own lead of the Premier League with a 6–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, which pushes the visitors further into relegation trouble just one season after they narrowly missed out on a UEFA Cup place.
도르트문트 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Brazil 's 크루제이루 2–0. The goals for the Germans are scored by Michael Zorc and Heiko Herrlich .
아스널 cut 맨체스터 유나이티드's advantage in the Premier League title race by beating them 3–2 at Highbury. Teddy Sheringjam scores twice for United, while 니콜라 아넬카 scores his first Gunners goal.
Michele Padovano , 유벤투스 striker, joins 크리스털 팰리스 for £1.7million.

Premier League officials express their desire for a two-up, two-down system to operate between the top two divisions in English football, which would spell at end to the traditional three-up and three-down system which has been in use since 1974 (with an exception to four seasons between 1986 and 1995 when the league was being restructured). It also wants to give member clubs the option to withdraw from the Football League Cup .
맨체스터 유나이티드 bounce back from their 아스널 defeat by returning to London and achieving a 5–2 away win over 윔블던. 아스널, meanwhile, suffer a shock 2–0 defeat at struggling 셰필드 웬즈데이.
Iran qualify for the 1998 World Cup at the expense of Australia , whose national coach Terry Venables steps down after one year in charge.

November draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the Premier League, with 첼시, 블랙번 로버스 and 리즈 유나이티드 putting up a strong challenge, while 아스널's title bid appears to be fading away as they now occupy fifth place and are seven points off the top. 에버턴 are now bottom of the top division where they have so far played for 44 seasons in succession, with 반즐리 and 볼턴 원더러스 completing the bottom three. 노팅엄 포리스트 are still top of Division One and 미들즈브러 are second. The playoff zone is occupied by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 셰필드 유나이티드, 스윈던 타운 and 찰턴 애슬레틱, while 스톡포트 카운티 are on the edge of the playoff zone as surprise contenders for a second successive promotion.
